name: Lincoln Your Blue Store
accessibility: Accessible parking, automatic entrances, check-in, clear signage, room for mobility devices and a wheelchair scale. The website notes that restroom maneuvering space may be inadequate for some power wheelchair users.

name: The Alcove
accessibility: Main floor accessible, with a second-floor elevator and an accessible second-floor bathroom. The listing notes bathroom doors open inward and an emergency evacuation plan is in development.

name: Aging Well Inc.
accessibility: Accessible rooms and garden, with wave-operated bathroom doors and a basement elevator. The listing notes an alternate route is currently needed for some outdoor access.

name: Save The Bay Center
address: 100 Save The Bay Drive, Providence, RI 02905
accessibility: Accessible parking and entrance; the center's rooms and patio are wheelchair accessible. Restrooms may be a tight fit for some users.

name: Save The Bay's Hamilton Family Aquarium
accessibility: Push-button entry, wheelchair-accessible exhibits, nearby accessible parking and a RIPTA bus depot. Restrooms may be tighter than usual.

name: East Providence Senior Center
accessibility: Push-button accessible doors and supportive activity spaces. The listing notes parking-area construction and some tight restrooms.

name: East Providence City Hall
accessibility: Two accessible spaces near the entrance and additional street parking. The website notes that some restrooms are tight and remodeling is planned.

name: The Coast Guard House
accessibility: Accessible parking, first-floor entry and seasonal igloo ramps, elevator to the second floor, and accessible restrooms. The listing includes details of maneuvering space in the elevator.

name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Rhode Island
accessibility: Accessible parking, automatic doors, signage, restrooms and locker rooms, plus adjustable desks and clear circulation paths.
